records.title: Solipsism and Theory of Mind
records.source_file: Prior ChatGPT conversation — Theory of Mind / solipsism coin-model route
records.chat_source_excerpt: Theory of Mind was developed as a model for inferring another person's mind rather than claiming direct access to it. Keeper: ‘Theory of Mind is useful because humans infer minds; it is dangerous when inference pretends to be access.’ The neighbouring solipsism/coin-model route treated self and other as distinguishable faces within one contact problem. The Theory of Mind body is source-confirmed; Solipsism was not recovered as a separate completed standalone.
records.boundary: Conversation-memory recovery proves the prior chat route and its relation to the existing Theory of Mind body. It does not claim a separately completed Solipsism manuscript or replace the fuller chat export.

records.title: Mini Lab Concept
records.source_file: Prior ChatGPT conversation — Mini Lab / Experiment Room / Thought Throne
records.chat_source_excerpt: Mini Lab / Experiment Room / Thought Throne was built as a controlled contact-field for testing JM ideas, syntax, games, theories, apps, visuals, body signals and life-use cases. Core law: ‘The throne protects meaning. The lab proves movement.’ Keeper: ‘The Thought Throne is where the source sits, but the lab makes the source prove movement.’ It advanced into Scientific Thought-Lab / Experimental Throne / TBS ThoughtLab v0.2, using thought experiment, simulation, safe physical demonstration, cross-science translation and TraceBox proof.
records.boundary: This recovers a real v0.1–v0.2 working body and its keepers from the prior conversation. The complete original chat/export is still the higher source authority.

records.title: Jentil Meshing Theory
records.source_file: Prior ChatGPT conversations — Jentil Meshing / missing-brick architecture
records.chat_source_excerpt: JM — Jentil Meshing was defined as the joining principle: join things without collapsing them into sameness. Governing distinction: ‘Mesh ≠ merge; contact ≠ collapse.’ The missing-brick architecture carried the keeper: ‘A missing brick is only weakness when the wall did not know it was missing.’ Whole Human Systems remains the wider umbrella; Jentil Meshing is the joining/contact principle inside it.
records.boundary: This route belongs with the existing Jentil Meshing / Contact Field body. It is source-backed lineage, not permission to create a duplicate theory.

records.title: Literalism Creation Idea
records.source_file: Prior ChatGPT conversation — EL-Literalism / Original Theory for Reality
records.chat_source_excerpt: The Literalism Creation Idea routes into the established EL-Literalism / Original Theory for Reality body. Root axiom: X = X; a representation or model is not the thing. Guard: M(X) approximates or represents X while M(X) is not X. The linked FTR route keeps Thing, Encounter and Record distinct and provides Ramp, Door and Moving Platform access structures.
records.boundary: This placeholder should point into EL-Literalism / Original Theory for Reality rather than form a duplicate body. The remembered route is source-confirmed, while the mounted HTML/body remains authoritative.

records.title: Observer and Observation Paradox
records.source_file: Prior ChatGPT conversations — observer-effect domain / Observational Inheritance
records.chat_source_excerpt: The active observer-effect lane focused on ‘observation changes the observer’ and on the surviving observable trace of that change. The developed route was named Observational Inheritance / Delayed Self-Observability. Keeper: ‘Second-order observation watches the observer. Observational inheritance watches what survives them.’ The wider body also preserved the caution that the observer does not necessarily manufacture the observed.
records.boundary: This is an admitted/developed theory route but was not yet fully source-mapped or frozen as a complete standalone. The graft records its authoritative conversation lineage without upgrading its completion state.
